rationale.conceptual: The method couples tight-binding Hamiltonian construction, NEGF formalism for ballistic transmission, elastic disorder correction, and Landauer-Buttiker thermoelectric integrals. While each component is textbook-level, their integration and correct implementation for a specific GNR geometry require careful physics understanding and are more than a simple API call.
